request.style: English, gentle female solo voice, acoustic guitar, soft piano, light percussion, warm strings, hopeful and steady, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Four kings marched to war that day
Against the five in the valley
Twelve years they served Chedorlaomer
But in the thirteenth, they rebelled
The Valley of Siddim had pits
Where kings of Sodom fell
The goods of Sodom were seized
And Lot was taken away

[Chorus]
I raised my hand to God Most High
Maker of heaven and earth
I will accept nothing from you
Not a thread or sandal strap
So you can never say
I made Abram rich

[Verse]
Three hundred eighteen men arose
Born in Abram’s household
He pursued the army to Dan
And struck them by night
He recovered all the goods
And brought back Lot his kinsman
The king of Sodom came out
To meet him in the King’s Valley

[Chorus]
I raised my hand to God Most High
Maker of heaven and earth
I will accept nothing from you
Not a thread or sandal strap
So you can never say
I made Abram rich

[Bridge]
Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre
Shall take their share of food
But Abram takes nothing else
From the king’s greedy hand
His oath is strong and true
Before the Maker of all

[Chorus]
I raised my hand to God Most High
Maker of heaven and earth
I will accept nothing from you
Not a thread or sandal strap
So you can never say
I made Abram rich

[Outro]
Not a thread
Not a sandal strap
